I found no bugs in the uncommitted changes.

- **The change:** `src/blib2to3/pgen2/tokenize.py` replaces the separate f-string flags (`fstring_level`, `inside_fstring_braces`, `inside_fstring_colon`, `bracelev`) with a single `FStringState` stack. I read the new state transitions: nested f-strings, nested braces inside format specs, and `}` handling all look consistent. The `CHANGES.md` entry and the new `pep_701.py` cases are fine.
- **The new cases work.** With the safety check turned off, the new inputs (`f"{1:{f'{2}'}}"` and `f'{1:{2}d}'`) format correctly. So do a few other nested format-spec cases I tried, such as `f"{x:{y}d}{z!r:>{w}}"`.
- **Test failures I did not investigate:**
  - `tests/test_format.py::test_simple_format[pep_701]` fails with an `ASTSafetyError`. It fails the same way with the changes stashed. Python 3.13's own parser rejects a multi-line f-string on line 77 of the test file, a line this diff doesn't touch. So the new test lines are not actually checked here.
  - Eight tests in `tests/test_black.py` failed with an uvloop `DeprecationWarning`. I did not check whether they fail without the changes.
- **Setup:** I ran the tests with `PYTHONPATH=src`, because otherwise Python imports the `black` installed in site-packages instead of the repository's code.

PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest tests/test_format.py tests/test_tokenize.py tests/test_black.py -q 2>&1 | tail -8
